method: Read public HTML of iwenbo.fun venue pages; extract named TMap.LatLng marker without loading Tencent SDK or using any key. The displayed marker uses Tencent GCJ-02 coordinates; iterative GCJ-02 inverse conversion produces WGS84. Official address and, when present, named OSM building geometry were cross-checked. Marker is not represented as surveyed doorway.
